messages:
Sophia: Heads-up — we have a docs PR that needs to land before the feature-flag cutoff tomorrow 16:00 PT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. It's a quickfix: update SDK example, add migration note, and fix one broken anchor. Who can review/approve?
Liam: I can do a quick technical pass this morning. Do we have a docs preview URL yet?
Maya: I opened the PR earlier. Preview is at https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4123 — mkdocs failed initially on a broken anchor on the SDK-snippets page. I pushed a tentative fix in branch `docs/4123-anchor-fix`.
Alex (CI-bot): docs-preview build failed: ERROR: Broken link: "./sdk/python/old-api" referenced in docs/sdk/snippets.md:42
Build output excerpt:
  - docs/sdk/snippets.md:42: broken link to ./sdk/python/old-api
  - mkdocs.exceptions.ConfigurationError: One or more page(s) contain invalid links
Liam: OK will check snippets.md. If it's just an old path we can update to `/sdk/python/compat` or add a redirect. @Maya can you re-run the preview after your branch update? :thumbsup:
Maya: Re-run kicked off: `./ci run docs-preview --pr 4123` — CI job id 8912.
Alex (CI-bot): docs-preview build queued (job 8912)... build completed ✅. Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4123/ — screenshot: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/8912/preview.png
Liam: Quick review done. Found one tiny wording nit in the Python snippet (explicitly set `timeout=30`), fixed in a 1-line commit to `docs/4123-anchor-fix`. Also replaced the broken anchor link to `/sdk/python/compat`. LGTM.
Jordan: Release note: cutoff is tomorrow 16:00 PT, but we need merges by 14:00 PT to allow smoke tests and docsite propagation. If CI green and eng approves, we'll slot this in. Also, if this touches versioned docs, bump the version dir (e.g., `v1.2`) or add a changelog entry.
Maya: This is just under the unversioned /guides path; no version bump needed. I confirmed the preview looks right.
Liam: Approved from eng. Please merge when ready.
Jordan: Approved for merge slot. Merge message should be: `docs: fix sdk snippet + anchor (PR #4123)`. Merge window open until 14:00 PT tomorrow.
Maya: Merged at 13:05 PT. Pushed to `main`. :tada: I'll run the staging smoke tests now.
Deploy-bot: staging deploy started for commit `a7f3c9d` — status: in_progress
Deploy-bot: staging deploy successful ✅ — smoke tests: all green (end-to-end samples ran).
Maya: Staging looks good. Closing this thread — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. If anyone sees a rendering issue on production docs after cutover, ping me here and I'll open a follow-up PR. :wave:
